pattern: Your [Bank] account KYC has expired. Update immediately or account will be blocked.
description: Fake KYC expiry message impersonating banks. Creates urgency to click malicious links.
examples: Dear customer your SBI account KYC has expired update immediately at http://sbi-kyc.xyz or your account will be blocked within 24 hours
Your PNB KYC is pending click http://pnb-update.in to complete verification or account will be suspended
HDFC Bank KYC Alert: Your account will be deactivated in 48 hours. Complete eKYC now at http://hdfc-ekyc.com
Axis Bank Notice: KYC verification required. Your account access will be restricted. Update at http://axis-verify.tk

pattern: TRAI has decided to disconnect your mobile number due to illegal activity.
description: Fake TRAI (Telecom Regulatory Authority of India) automated call or message threatening mobile disconnection.
examples: TRAI has decided to disconnect your mobile number within 2 hours due to illegal activity press 1 to speak to officer
Your mobile number is being used for illegal purposes TRAI will disconnect within 24 hours call this number to avoid disconnection
This is an automated message from TRAI your SIM card has been linked to fraud activities press 1 for verification
Department of Telecom alert your number will be disconnected in 4 hours due to non-compliance verify your identity now

pattern: You have received a payment request. Accept to receive money in your account.
description: Fake UPI collect request disguised as incoming payment. Victim approves thinking they will receive money but actually pays money.
red_flags: No need to enter PIN to receive money
examples: You have received a payment of Rs 5000 from UNKNOWN accept to receive money in your bank account
Hi I am the buyer from OLX sending you advance payment of Rs 10000 please accept the UPI request
Congratulations you have received cashback of Rs 500 from PhonePe accept the collect request to claim
Your refund of Rs 2000 is ready to be processed please approve the UPI collect request to receive

pattern: Scan this QR code to receive your refund/cashback/prize money.
description: QR code scam where scanning leads to payment deduction instead of receiving money.
red_flags: QR codes are for paying not receiving
examples: Scan this QR code to receive your Amazon refund of Rs 1500 directly to your bank account
Your cashback of Rs 2000 is ready scan QR to claim before it expires today
Olx buyer here scan this QR code and enter your UPI PIN to receive payment of Rs 8000
Government subsidy of Rs 3000 credited scan QR code to transfer to your bank account

pattern: Click this link to verify/update/claim your [service] account.
description: Phishing links disguised as legitimate service notifications. URLs contain misspelled brand names or suspicious TLDs.
examples: Your Flipkart order has been cancelled click http://flipkart-refund.tk to claim refund
Amazon Prime membership expiring click http://amazn-renew.xyz to avoid losing benefits
Your Google account has been compromised secure it now at http://google-secure.ml
Netflix billing failed update payment at http://netflix-payment.in to continue watching

pattern: Your electricity/gas/water connection will be disconnected. Pay immediately.
description: Fake utility disconnection threats with payment links. Targets fear of essential service loss.
examples: URGENT your electricity connection will be disconnected in 2 hours pay Rs 500 now at this link to avoid disconnection
Your BSES bill is overdue pay immediately at http://bses-pay.in or supply will be cut today
Gas connection alert pending payment of Rs 1200 pay now at http://indane-pay.com to avoid disconnection
Water supply will be stopped tomorrow due to non-payment clear dues at http://jal-board-pay.xyz

pattern: Share your OTP to complete verification/claim prize/process refund.
description: Social engineering to extract OTP for unauthorized transactions.
red_flags: OTP should never be shared with anyone
Caller claims to be bank official
examples: IRCTC has selected your number for free ticket share your OTP to claim booking
This is SBI customer care we need your OTP to verify suspicious transaction on your account
Your Amazon order refund requires OTP verification please share the OTP sent to your number
To process your insurance claim of Rs 50000 please share the OTP we just sent to your phone

pattern: Your credit/debit card has been blocked/compromised. Share details to reactivate.
description: Fake card blocking alerts to steal card details including CVV and expiry date.
red_flags: Call from unknown number claiming to be bank
examples: SBI Alert your debit card 4XXX has been blocked due to suspicious activity call 1800XXXXXX to reactivate immediately
Your HDFC credit card has been compromised share your card number and CVV to block unauthorized transactions
ICICI bank your card ending 5678 has been suspended verify by sharing complete card details and OTP
Your credit card application is approved share your PAN Aadhaar and existing card details to process delivery

pattern: Invest today and earn guaranteed returns of X%. Join our WhatsApp/Telegram group.
description: Fake investment schemes promising unrealistic returns. Often promoted via WhatsApp and Telegram groups.
examples: Invest Rs 5000 today and earn Rs 50000 guaranteed within 7 days join our WhatsApp group for daily stock tips
FREE IPO alert invest in XYZ Tech launching tomorrow guaranteed 200% returns transfer money to this UPI
Earn Rs 1 lakh monthly from crypto trading join our premium Telegram channel invest minimum Rs 10000
Government-backed investment scheme earn 15% monthly returns zero risk register now limited slots available

pattern: Congratulations! You have won a lottery/lucky draw/prize. Click to claim.
description: Fake lottery and prize notifications designed to extract personal and financial details.
red_flags: You cannot win a lottery you never entered
examples: Congratulations you have won Rs 50 lakh in Amazon Lucky Draw click here to claim http://amazon-prize.tk
KBC lottery winner your number selected for Rs 25 lakh prize call this number to collect your winnings
Jio Lucky Draw you won an iPhone 16 and Rs 5 lakh pay Rs 999 processing fee to claim your prize
WhatsApp lottery you have been selected as winner of Rs 1 crore forward your Aadhaar and PAN to claim

pattern: Your Aadhaar/PAN has been suspended due to suspicious activity.
description: Fake government document suspension notices to steal personal identity details.
red_flags: Aadhaar/PAN cannot be suspended via SMS
examples: Your Aadhaar card has been suspended due to unusual activity visit http://aadhaar-reactivate.com to resolve
PAN card linked to suspicious transactions verify at http://incometax-verify.in or face legal action
Your Aadhaar and PAN must be linked immediately or your bank account will be frozen click http://link-aadhaar.xyz
UIDAI alert your Aadhaar biometrics need updating visit nearest center or update online at http://aadhaar-update.tk

pattern: Your son/daughter/relative has been arrested. Transfer money immediately.
description: Emergency scam calls claiming a family member is in trouble and needs immediate money.
red_flags: Prevents you from contacting the relative directly
examples: Your son has been arrested by cyber crime cell transfer Rs 25000 to release him immediately call this number
Your daughter has been involved in an accident she is in hospital transfer Rs 50000 for emergency treatment
Police custody alert your relative found with drugs pay Rs 1 lakh bail amount to this UPI immediately
Your family member detained at airport for smuggling pay fine of Rs 75000 to customs officer UPI ID

pattern: Your income tax refund is pending. Click to process.
description: Fake income tax refund notifications with phishing links to steal banking credentials.
red_flags: IT department uses official portal only
Refund links via SMS are always fake
examples: Income Tax Department your refund of Rs 15000 is pending click http://incometax-refund.in to process instantly
ITR refund approved Rs 24500 credited to your account update bank details at http://it-refund.xyz to receive
Your income tax penalty of Rs 5000 is due pay immediately at http://it-penalty.com to avoid legal notice
Dear taxpayer your assessment year 2025-26 refund ready verify PAN at http://pan-verify-it.in to process

pattern: Pre-approved loan/credit card offer with instant approval.
description: Fake pre-approved loan or credit card offers to collect personal and financial documents.
examples: Congratulations your CIBIL score qualifies you for pre-approved loan of Rs 10 lakh at 0% interest click http://loan-offer.xyz
HDFC pre-approved credit card with Rs 5 lakh limit share Aadhaar and PAN to process home delivery
Instant personal loan Rs 3 lakh no documents needed just pay Rs 2000 processing fee at this UPI ID
Your salary account qualifies for special loan at 2% interest apply now share your last 3 months bank statement

pattern: FASTag recharge failed. Pay immediately or vehicle will be blacklisted.
description: Fake FASTag and vehicle-related payment scams targeting vehicle owners.
red_flags: FASTag managed through official apps only
examples: FASTag recharge failed your vehicle toll account will be blacklisted tomorrow click http://fastag-pay.in to recharge
Your vehicle insurance expired pay Rs 500 renewal at http://vehicle-insure.xyz to avoid challan
Traffic challan of Rs 2000 issued for your vehicle pay online at http://echallan-pay.com to avoid court hearing
Your driving license renewal pending pay fee at http://dl-renew.in or license will be cancelled
